scope: Independent decoded-byte to task8 private-load layout adapter; no shared-memory bypass, no codec format change
clock_reset: One clk, synchronous active-low rst_n. Reset discards offered output only when both attached internal-stream endpoints are also reset.
start: start_valid/ready captures start_mode_w: 0=X99x64, 1=W64x32. Accepted only while idle. Every START invalidates both buffer slots and old epoch; data RAM is not reset.
input: 32-bit little-endian four-byte beats, in_count must equal 4. X exactly1584 beats, W exactly512. in_last true exactly at final beat. Producer must hold all fields stable until accepted.
X_output: 1600 words: for i, rp=i/32,kp=i%32, bytes low-to-high X[2rp,2kp],X[2rp,2kp+1],X[2rp+1,2kp],X[2rp+1,2kp+1]. Missing row99 is generated as zero locally. These extra16 output words still require real downstream ACKs.
W_output: 512 words: for i,kp=i/16,lp=i%16, bytes low-to-high W[2kp,2lp],W[2kp+1,2lp],W[2kp,2lp+1],W[2kp+1,2lp+1]. Each stream is one32-column group, covering two16-column compute tiles.
output_protocol: out_valid,data,last,index remain stable under !out_ready, including input/upstream errors. Successful done is a one-cycle pulse following final output handshake, never input completion alone.
error_protocol: Sticky error_code1=count,2=early last,3=missing last,4=upstream_error. On error no new output is offered, but a previously offered word is retained until ACK. Malformed input drains to last or upstream_error. Upstream_error declares producer has stopped generating new payload; any already offered beat is consumed/discarded in that error cycle. A permanent missing last without upstream_error, or permanent downstream stall, requires enclosing watchdog/reset and cannot be called drained. New START requires old busy to clear.
buffer: 64x32bit data registers=2048 data bits, two128-byte ping-pong slots. W uses first64bytes per slot. X tail uses first64bytes and literal zero upper halves. No additional data output register; offered output reads an immutable completed slot. Control/counters/mux area is additional.
performance: Target one accepted input beat and one output word per cycle after fill. Report actual accepted START through final output ACK cycles including first fill, slot boundary bubbles, X padding, all stalls. No frequency/area/power claim.
integration_limits: upstream_error must connect decoder error, not an unqualified shared global signal belonging to another epoch. START/reset coordination belongs to enclosing controller. This module does not own outstanding ICB commands and does not cancel or synthesize bus responses.
verification: Independent Python direct-index golden, actual frozen INT8 validation sample9 all12 X plus8 W groups/layer, synthetic extremes/random, four-state uninitialized buffer, held interfaces, fill/output/reset epochs, malformed count/last/upstream error, complete cycles. No fitting of numerical/codec parameters.
